mapper.select: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CPU_PERCENT),1) AS "cpu_percent", ROUND(AVG(CPU_USER),1) AS "cpu_user", ROUND(AVG(CPU_SYSTEM),1) AS "cpu_system", ROUND(AVG(CPU_IOWAIT),1) AS "cpu_iowait", ROUND(AVG(MEM_TOTAL_GB),1) AS "mem_total_gb", ROUND(AVG(MEM_USED_GB),1) AS "mem_used_gb", ROUND(AVG(MEM_FREE_GB),1) AS "mem_free_gb", ROUND(AVG(MEM_PERCENT),1) AS "mem_percent", COUNT(*) AS "cnt" FROM INSP_OS_HISTORY WHERE COLLECTED_AT >= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{yesterday}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND COLLECTED_AT < TO_TIMESTAMP(#{today}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

SELECT ROUND(AVG(cpu_percent)::numeric,1) AS "cpu_percent", ROUND(AVG(cpu_user)::numeric,1) AS "cpu_user", ROUND(AVG(cpu_system)::numeric,1) AS "cpu_system", ROUND(AVG(cpu_iowait)::numeric,1) AS "cpu_iowait", ROUND(AVG(mem_total_gb)::numeric,1) AS "mem_total_gb", ROUND(AVG(mem_used_gb)::numeric,1) AS "mem_used_gb", ROUND(AVG(mem_free_gb)::numeric,1) AS "mem_free_gb", ROUND(AVG(mem_percent)::numeric,1) AS "mem_percent", COUNT(*) AS "cnt" FROM insp_os_history WHERE collected_at >= to_timestamp(#{yesterday},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND collected_at < to_timestamp(#{today},'YYYY-MM-DD')

SELECT YEAR_MONTH AS "year_month", CPU_AVG AS "cpu_avg", MEM_AVG AS "mem_avg", MEM_USED_GB AS "mem_used_gb", MEM_TOTAL_GB AS "mem_total_gb", DISK_AVG AS "disk_avg", DISK_USED_GB AS "disk_used_gb", DISK_TOTAL_GB AS "disk_total_gb" FROM INSP_MONTHLY_SUMMARY WHERE YEAR_MONTH LIKE #{yearPrefix} ORDER BY YEAR_MONTH

SELECT year_month AS "year_month", cpu_avg AS "cpu_avg", mem_avg AS "mem_avg", mem_used_gb AS "mem_used_gb", mem_total_gb AS "mem_total_gb", disk_avg AS "disk_avg", disk_used_gb AS "disk_used_gb", disk_total_gb AS "disk_total_gb" FROM insp_monthly_summary WHERE year_month LIKE #{yearPrefix} ORDER BY year_month
